text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Excuse me! May I ask you something?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I've been wanting to ask someone for a 
while. But thinking this worry might just 
be due to my own immaturity, I couldn't 
bring myself to... Um—

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
How much of a reward do you think is 
appropriate for a hardworking Umamusume 
without going overboard?!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"I'm really at a loss. Because Meek is 
always such a hard worker!"

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Would a trip to the bakery be within 
acceptable limits if it's only once a 
week?!
